title: Honey cocoa oat squares
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Honey cocoa oat squares. Ingredient reference: Cocoa powder, Honey, Rolled oats, Butter, Ground walnuts. Preparation reference: One batch makes 8 portions. Preparation: 15 minutes; cooking: 20 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 170 C conventional and line a 20 cm square tin with baking paper. Melt the butter and honey in a saucepan over low heat, stirring for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and mix in the cocoa powder until smooth. Stir in the rolled oats and ground walnuts until evenly coated. Press firmly into the tin with the back of a spoon. Bake for 20 minutes. Leave in the tin until completely cool, about 30 minutes, so the mixture firms up; then cut into eight squares..
